description: This file defines an abstract class 'MethodObject' that represents a generic object used as a parameter in the mini-language methods within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides abstract methods for retrieving the object, its class type, and its name, to be implemented by subclasses.

classes.name: MethodObject
classes.description: An abstract class representing an object value used as a parameter in minilang methods.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the object value within a given method context.

methods.name: getTypeClass
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the class type of the object.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Abstract method to get the type name of the object.
